name: Beach leisure spot (open parasol + towel + bucket, shovel and starfish scatter)

anchor.note: dx/dy are tile offsets from the top-left of the footprint; the parasol anchors the back row and the towel/toys spread out in front of it on the sand. Height is 6, not 5: towel (dy=4, 32px/2-tile-tall sprite) needs rows 4-5.

offset_basis_summary: Umbrella, towel, bucket, shovel and starfish singles live in unrelated rows/columns of the 21_Beach sheet (umbrella at ~y208, towel at ~y96, bucket at ~y32, shovel at ~y32, starfish at ~y64-80), so every offset here is hand-authored to form a plausible sunbathing spot: parasol shading the towel, toys scattered beside it.

pieces.notes: Open blue beach umbrella; shades the towel spot below it.
Lies flat beside the bucket, propped against it.
Loose decorative scatter on the sand; swap color variant freely.

variants.umbrella_color: Swap me.beach.umbrella_blue_open for green/lightblue open variants; keep towel/toy colors independent.
variants.toy_scatter: bucket/shovel/starfish are all optional scatter; drop any subset for a sparser spot.

notes: Loose leisure scatter group (not a single sheet-derived multi_tile me.*): mirrors how beach chairs/umbrellas/toys are strewn near each other on real beach scenes. Do not stamp me.beach.umbrella_blue_open alone expecting towel/toys nearby -- author as this grp for a complete spot.
